title: Inflation has come down from its 2022 peak — but stalled above 2%
intro: US consumer-price inflation, year-on-year, from the official CPI-U index (BLS via FRED). It peaked at 8.5% in 2022 and has since eased to around 3–4%, still above the Federal Reserve’s 2% target.
altInsight: US year-on-year CPI inflation rose from under 2% in 2019 to a peak of 8.5% in mid-2022, then fell back to roughly 3-4% by 2026, remaining above the 2% target.
